title: Ask, Never Demand: What Thaurissan Called

objectives.text: Hear the Shade of a Dark Iron Runewright
says: Ye can see me. Two hundred years an' more, an' ye're the first tae stop. I cut the runes, ye ken. No' the words. I only cut what I was given.
We were losin'. Both our kin at the gates. The Thane said there was a power under the stone that would end it, an' it would come if it was called by its right name.
It came. It didnae ask what we wanted. There was a mountain range here, did ye know? My grandbairns' grandbairns haul slag for it still. Put out one flame o' it for me.

texts.details:
Now the worst of them. Go to the Searing Gorge, in the dwarven lands, south of Loch Modan.

More than two hundred years ago there was a war between the dwarf clans, and the Dark Irons were losing it. Their sorcerer-thane, Thaurissan, would not lose. He and seven others reached down for a power to destroy their enemies. They did not ask. They summoned.

What came was Ragnaros, the lord of all fire. It killed them where they stood. It broke a range of mountains. And it has owned the Dark Irons ever since.

There is a shade near Thorium Point, one who had a hand in it. Hear him. Then go south into the Cauldron and put out a little of what he helped to call.
texts.objectives: Hear the Shade of a Dark Iron Runewright south-west of Thorium Point in the Searing Gorge and destroy Thaurissan's Answer in the Cauldron. Return to Kardris Dreamseeker in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
texts.progress: He will not ask your pardon. Hear him anyway.
texts.completion:
He cut what he was given. Yes. There is always one who only cut the runes.

Do you see why I sent an orc's pupil to hear a dwarf? We were losing, too. We too were offered a power that would come when called and not ask what we wanted. They took fire, and now fire commands them. We took the blood, and you know the rest.

That is the end of every demand, $N. The elements answer it. They always answer. They only choose how.

You have asked, all this way. So in a hard hour, you will be answered differently.

Sixty seasons. There is one more.

idea: Ask, Never Demand, level 50: the summoning of Ragnaros. From the wiki: facing defeat in the War of the Three Hammers, Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan and the Seven summoned Ragnaros to destroy their enemies; they were killed at once, the blast shattered the Redridge range and raised Blackrock, and the Dark Irons have served the Firelord since. Gives the perk of the elements answering in a hard fight. Invented: the runewright's shade and the elemental named Thaurissan's Answer.
